game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the potions value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the hold gate using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The hold gate reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the hold gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ice Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The hold gate reached with actions_used <= 22.
